title: Eureka Brass Band, parades and carnival at Thibodaux
summary: The local Eureka Brass Band, its size, occasional parades by societies, and the Thibodaux carnival.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you ever have any brass bands up in the country or parades that you can remember?
Yeah, I used to have a band in Tippit Oval. Call it, uh, Eureka Brass Band.
Or, same as, Eureka, same name as they had here then?
Yeah. No, Eureka, that's right, the Eureka Brass Band. We had about the best band out on the bayou. Did you play in it later then?
No, I didn't play in it.
You didn't play in it?
Yeah.
What was that name again?
Eureka Brass Band. Eureka? Yeah. Uh-huh. Something like Eureka, I believe it's Eureka Brass Band.
It's a little different name.
Yeah.
Um, how big a band was it about?
Oh, it was about 12, 14 pieces. Pretty big band then.
Yeah.
Then you, he came down here one, uh, I think it was the old fellas then, he won the prize.
Well, you did, I never played. Were you playing in that band? No, I didn't play in it. So you never did play in it?
No, I never did play in it. In fact, I was, I was small. Oh, yeah.

Did they have many parades up there on the holidays? Or what did they have parades for? Like, I didn't hear they have them on Sunday, almost every Sunday, you know, in the summer. Yeah, I know, I know that. Did they have them very often up there?

Sometimes they have a parade, uh, like the old fellas turn out like that, well, they have a little parade. For the different organizations then? Yeah. See, and them times, uh, they used to play for that carnival in Tebido.
Well, they have, do they have a pretty big, uh, celebration up there for carnival too?
Yeah, they have, they have about five or six floats. They do? Mm-hmm. Used to have two bands. Yeah. They had Tebido and the band from Donner from there.
Oh, yeah.
